titel: Ep 358: Smart ways for your business to stay relevant in 2026, 2027.

einzeiler: Discover which business models are actually thriving and how to stay relevant in 2026.
kurzfassung: The business landscape is shifting rapidly due to AI and market changes, making frequent strategy check-ins essential. In-person experiences, handmade goods, and local services are currently thriving as consumers seek authentic human connections. Conversely, traditional online courses and standard e-commerce models face heavy saturation and require hybrid approaches or strong personal branding to succeed.
stichpunkte: In-person retreats, workshops, and wellness tourism are booming as consumers seek genuine human connection.
Handmade and human-made goods command premium prices because buyers are fatigued by AI-generated products.
Local referral-driven services remain largely unaffected by shifting digital algorithms.
E-commerce platforms like Etsy serve as useful discovery channels, but tightening rules and AI listings require caution.
Print-on-demand businesses face heavy saturation, making a tight niche and loyal audience essential for success.
Independent websites require active ad spend and existing audiences to gain visibility over traditional Google rankings.
Stand-alone digital courses struggle to sell, requiring hybrid group programs or one-on-one coaching to provide real transformation.

clips.hook: People are paying big money for in-person experiences.
clips.text: Consumers are willing to spend heavily on live gatherings, painting workshops, and multi-day getaways due to widespread social isolation.

clips.hook: Wellness tourism is heading from 661 billion toward 1.4 trillion by 2027.
clips.text: The global health tourism market is projected to reach $1.4 trillion by 2027, driven by strong growth in expert-hosted travel programs.

clips.hook: People are sick of the AI slop that's out there.
clips.text: Creators who craft physical products should photograph their work, build local visibility, and design items that customers naturally want to share.
Selling standalone educational videos is increasingly difficult because artificial intelligence provides free answers, making live cohort coaching much more effective.

clips.hook: If you fall behind, you will become irrelevant.
clips.text: The host concludes the episode by offering personal mentorship to help listeners navigate their entrepreneurial paths.

beschreibung:
It's time to look at your business and ensure you are offering what people want to pay for - and how they want to receive it. Today we're talking about ways you can offer your products and services to stay relevant in 2026 and 2027 to increase your sales.
